blocks.text: Missnine Hobo Bag Purses and Handbags for Women Top Handle Handbags with Pocket Zipper

items.label: 2024 Trendy Hobo Purse
items.value: The zipper and stitching form a unique cross design, and the classic bag body makes this bag a chic accessory for women to go out and offers enough room.

items.label: Lightweight & Large Capacity
items.value: This top handle handbag is only 1.1lb; Dimension: 12" x 5.31" x 11.4", and features a large main compartment, enough for your keys, notebook, umbrella, wallet, sunglasses, phone, and tablet(up to 11").

items.label: Secured Design
items.value: The main compartment features a zipper closure, and 2 external zipper pockets both all focused on protecting your essentials. With an inner zipper bag and an inner bag, there are enough pockets to keep your items well organized.

items.label: Comfort & Versatility
items.value: The tight stitching improves the durability of the bag, and the two shoulder straps provide different ways of carrying, suitable for work, travel, college, and shopping, crossbody, shoulder, or tote, can't be limited to just one choice.

items.label: After-Sale Service
items.value: Missnine is committed to providing exceptional products and shopping experience. If you are not satisfied with our clear bag or service for any reason, please feel free to contact us by email and we will attempt to resolve any issues and ensure your satisfaction.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Spot clean, avoid excessive heat, store in a cool, dry place
